General SEO strategies often fall short for healthcare providers. Physical therapy practices require a nuanced approach that understands patient journeys, local search intent, medical compliance, and the specific services offered. A top-tier physical therapy digital firm will focus on:

  • Technical SEO: Optimizing your website for speed, mobile-friendliness, and crawlability.
  • Reputation Management: Helping you gather and showcase positive patient reviews.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Turning website visitors into actual appointments.
